punchline: In Harari's Dataism, the search box has taken the place feelings used to hold when people decide.
thirty_sec: Harari describes Dataism as valuing everything by its contribution to data processing. He says Google and Facebook algorithms already know how you feel and may come to know you better than you know yourself, and he cites Google Flu Trends, which caught flu outbreaks from search data. Critics find the claim unproven.
